data.name: 开局养成满级修士
data.detailed_description:
A single thought can lead to immortality, another to demonhood; your fingertips hold the Dao.

But this time, cultivation is more than just meditation and breakthroughs.

Establish your sect and nurture a diverse array of cultivators: from Qi Refining to Golden Core, each cultivator can freely combine nearly a hundred weapons and spells. Will they become sword cultivators, magic cultivators, or spellcasters? It's all up to you.

Manipulate good and evil, orchestrate chaos: You can unleash cultivators to slay demons, or unleash monsters to devour you! Cultivators can attack monsters, monsters can devour each other, and even—cultivators can fight for Dao lineage. The Dao is unpredictable; your choices are the variables.

A dynamic world, shaped by you: move mountains and fill seas, altering the terrain; unleash natural disasters to test all beings; bestow secret treasures to reverse fate. Your sect can not only earn spirit stones through labor, but also survive and thrive amidst calamities and opportunities…

Will you cultivate a legendary immortal sect, or nurture a chaotic demon realm?

Everything awaits your move.

Base-Building & Management​

Create and expand your faction. Deploy various units, manage gold resources, and expand your territory.

Deep Unit Development System​

Guide your units through progressive level breakthroughs. Freely combine a variety of weapons (such as swords, staffs, etc.) and magic to shape each unit’s unique combat style.

Conflict System​

Factions will wage war against one another.

World-Shaping Gameplay​

Wield god-like creation power to directly reshape the map terrain. Trigger catastrophic disasters or bestow items upon units, influencing all entities in the world.

Dynamic Sandbox Narrative​

A living, breathing open world where units, monsters, and factions all operate autonomously based on their own goals. Conflicts arise naturally—from clearing demonic beasts in the wild to competing for resources.

Game Genre:​ Strategy, Simulation, Sandbox

Worldview Setting:​ A dynamically evolving god-game with myth-inspired themes, offering an immersive sandbox experience blended with strategic management elements.

Estimated Playtime:​ As a sandbox game with no defined ending, playtime varies by player. A complete playthrough can take around 30 hours; diverse item combinations provide high replay value.
